description: Single source of truth for the Emscripten toolchain pin and compile/link flags. Consumed by wasm_renderer/build.sh (via scripts/format-wasm-compile-flags.js; the only build), scripts/emcc-version-gate.sh and the CI wasm job (setup-emsdk version must equal emsdkVersion). Export lists live in wasm_exports.json. ASYNCIFY is required by device.cpp WaitAny init — see wasm_renderer/BUILD_FLAG_EXPERIMENTS.md before touching it. GROWABLE_ARRAYBUFFERS=0 is deliberate (TextDecoder + resizable heap); do not flip without a Dawn re-test. extraFlags are plain em++ args (compile + link); -flto adopted 2026-10 (-12.5 KB .wasm). -sENVIRONMENT=web and -msimd128 were measured and rejected; see BUILD_FLAG_EXPERIMENTS.md. `sources` is the one translation-unit list (build.sh and `npm run wasm:compdb` both read it). `profiles.debug` adds -sASSERTIONS=2 + DWARF/source maps for `npm run wasm:build:debug` (output pixelocity_wasm.debug.{js,wasm}, gitignored, loaded by ?renderer=wasm&wasm_debug=1); an async export reached by a plain ccall throws there instead of returning a Promise. `emitTsd` and `linkSFlags` are release-only link args: ASYNCIFY_ADVISE prints which functions can suspend without changing the binary, and build.sh fails unless those exports are exactly the `async` ones in wasm_exports.json (scripts/check-asyncify-exports.mjs). the release build writes the module typings that verify:wasm-bridge-sync diffs against wasm_exports.json.

debug.description: Same code and flags as release plus Emscripten runtime assertions (ASSERTIONS=2 throws on a suspending export called without { async: true }), DWARF and a source map, and readable function names in stack traces.
